question: Is enjoyment of virtue fruit just in pleasure cause?
premises: In pleasure cause and pleasure, this has common intention.
Even from undifferentiated, it is just.
Enjoyment of virtue and other fruit follows.
inference: Common intention makes enjoyment of virtue fruit just even in undifferentiated pleasure.
uncertainties: sāmānyādabhisaṃdhitaḥ may mean from common intention or from generality.
plain_english: In pleasure cause and pleasure, this has common intention; even from undifferentiated, just enjoyment of virtue and other fruit follows.
